## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-1">:clipboard:</custom> Requirements

### Pricing Cards Grid

* As a potential customer I want to see pricing plans displayed in a clear card layout So that I can easily compare different subscription tiers
* Acceptance Criteria:

    * Display at least 3 pricing tiers (Basic, Premium, Enterprise)
    * Show price, billing period, and key features for each plan
    * Integrate variant switch between monthly and annually payment
    
        * display strikethrough prices
        
    * Include CTA button for each plan
    * Grid is a swipe slider on mobile
    
* A storybook story has been created, rendering the design from figma (not discounted, just the cards-grid)

## Technical Definition

### Molecule/Pricing/PricingGrid.vue

**Example usage**

```html
<PricingGrid :plans=[{...}]/>
```

| **Prop** | **Default** | **Type** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| plans | - | `PricingCardProps[]`  
See PricingCard-component |

On mobile, the cards are being displayed in a carousel. This is achieved by using Swiper.

Nuxt Swiper @1.2.2 (using the Swiperjs Vue API) is already installed and can be used.

* [Nuxt Swiper](https://github.com/cpreston321/nuxt-swiper/tree/v1.2.2) docs
* [Swiper.js Vue](https://swiperjs.com/vue) docs
* [Related PR](https://github.com/laioutr/laioutr/pull/75)

You can see the **animation in action** in the [figma dummy](https://www.figma.com/proto/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=3492-21109&p=f&m=dev&scaling=min-zoom&content-scaling=fixed&starting-point-node-id=3795%3A16289&show-proto-sidebar=1).

Use either the [coverflow-effect](https://swiperjs.com/swiper-api#coverflow-effect) or the [creative-effect](https://swiperjs.com/swiper-api#creative-effect) (see [Notion](https://www.notion.so/laioutr/Tips-Tricks-for-development-1835331c061e801ab7d7c68ecfff9e5f?pvs=4#1a55331c061e800fa5b6dcbc28bbd027) for resolution on unocss-problems with creative-effect) to achieve the effect shown in figma.

On desktop, we can still use swiper, we just have to hide the NavigationBullets and disable the effect.

For connecting the NavigationBullets to Swiper, you have to create the following new component:

### Molecule/Swiper/SwiperNavigationBullets.vue

**Example usage**

```
<Swiper>
  <SwiperSlide />
  <SwiperSlide />
  <SwiperSlide />
  
  <template #container-end>
    <SwiperNavigationBullets />
  </template>
</Swiper>
```

This component receives no props and no slots. It uses `useSwiper().realIndex` to figure out which slide is currently active and sends that to the NavigationBullets-component.

Also, clicking the bullets navigates to the corresponding card.

longDescription:
## Purpose

The PricingGrid component provides a responsive container for displaying multiple subscription plans in an easily comparable format. It adapts to different screen sizes to ensure optimal user experience across devices while maintaining clear pricing presentation.

## Use Cases

- Display three or more pricing tiers in a horizontal grid on desktop for easy side-by-side comparison
- Present pricing cards as a swipeable slider on mobile with engaging coverflow animation effects
- Allow users to navigate between plans using touch gestures or navigation bullet indicators
- Synchronize with billing cycle switches to update all cards simultaneously

## Design Rationale

Presenting pricing plans in a clear, comparable layout helps users make informed decisions quickly. The mobile carousel approach maintains usability on smaller screens while the coverflow effect provides visual engagement. Navigation bullets ensure users can access all plans without excessive swiping.
